counterexamples_before_fix: For both synthetic field verdicts, a test of impl1 and crit1 borrowed impl2 via crit1 ancestry and falsely covered req2, although the test never linked impl2.
A tested implementation linked req1 and crit1; the criterion linked req2. Traversing all implementation ancestors falsely credited req2 without an implementation-to-requirement path.
A result linked only baseline and criterion, while baseline linked the test. Traversing all result ancestors falsely credited the baseline's test as intervention evidence.
compatibility_control: Build-valid composition test to impl2 to impl1 to req1 remains accepted by validate when its result links the test directly.
current_rule: A decisive result counts only test IDs in its direct deps.
Each counted test must directly name its criterion and implementation.
Only implementation-to-implementation composition edges and direct requirement deps of those implementations establish requirement coverage; criterion and baseline paths do not.
